gloss: secret plan; secret strategy; trump card

definitions.gloss: secret plan; secret strategy; hidden trump card
definitions.explanation: A plan or strategy kept hidden until the right moment. Implies a clever or decisive measure that others do not expect.

examples.japanese: {秘策|ひさく}を{用意|ようい}してある。
examples.english: I have a secret plan prepared.

examples.japanese: {監督|かんとく}は{試合|しあい}に{勝|か}つための{秘策|ひさく}を{練|ね}っていた。
examples.english: The coach was devising a secret strategy to win the game.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げが{低迷|ていめい}していたが、{社長|しゃちょう}が{打|う}ち{出|だ}した{秘策|ひさく}のおかげで{業績|ぎょうせき}が{回復|かいふく}した。
examples.english: Sales had been sluggish, but thanks to the secret strategy the president unveiled, business performance recovered.

notes:
A compound of {秘|ひ} (secret; hidden) and {策|さく} (plan; strategy). Often used in dramatic or emphatic contexts — sports, business, storytelling — to describe a plan that turns the tide. The word carries a positive connotation, implying cleverness and foresight.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秘策|ひさく}を{練|ね}る: to devise a secret plan
- {秘策|ひさく}を{明|あ}かす: to reveal a secret plan
- {秘策|ひさく}を{用意|ようい}する: to prepare a secret strategy
- {秘策|ひさく}を{打|う}ち{出|だ}す: to put forward a secret strategy
- とっておきの{秘策|ひさく}: an ace up one's sleeve

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {作戦|さくせん}: strategy; tactics — a general plan of action, not necessarily secret
- {奥|おく}の{手|て}: trump card; last resort — a hidden technique or measure saved for a critical moment
- {裏技|うらわざ}: hidden trick; secret technique — a lesser-known method, often in games or daily life
